summary: Iteration 27 retest. Backend: 19 of 20 tests passed and 1 was skipped (tests/test_iter27_live_brand.py and test_iter26_brand_ds.py). The skip is NEAR order creation, which the upstream still answers with 503 'active incident ... paused'. /_live: relay on, every_s 3, ok goes up between calls, 0 errors, age_s about 1. Indexer stats (leaves 1200, nullifiers 313, root) are sent with cache-control no-store. The feed returns real signatures with ts. Token icons use opaque _img?o= keys that cannot be base64-decoded to an upstream URL, and they load as image/*. POST /api/ds/orders returns 'orderId' and no 'houdiniId'. Favicons are still the NullCash mark. Frontend: the 1024-1080 empty-pill bug is fixed; every visible tab has a label (55-115px wide) without a connected wallet. NEW BUG: at 1024-1100px with the connected wallet label (and at 1024/1040 even without it), 'Privacy swap' and the 'More' button are clipped by nav.side overflow:hidden, so the overflow tabs cannot be reached. No geometric overlap at 1024/1060/1280/1440/1920. /app/api renders (body opacity 1, bf-ready set) and its site-top CA chip copies the full CA; React #418 still logs but is harmless. On the landing page at 390px the CA chip stays on one line (height 40), there is no horizontal overflow and no X icon in the header. The hero 'live · synced Ns ago' resets 0-3s and stats requests repeat exactly every 5.0s. Private route SOL->USDC(ETH) 1.2 SOL: Total fees $2.48 (1.95%) matches the quote USD in/out ($127.14 -> $124.66), and the dk-fees rows are present. The order was created (eyjVibNrkjoeSUFPPekS8X); the dk-order-fees modal shows Total fees $2.20 (1.89%) plus every row, consistent with the card. Track shows WAITING FOR DEPOSIT and polls every 5.0s. Privacy swap SOL->ETH 0.8: Total $0.59 (0.69%); NullCash fee (0.40%) 0.0032 SOL · $0.34; Network fee (Ethereum) 0.000035 ETH · $0.09; Minimum received; Refund fee; Network gas; all consistent with the near/quote JSON. Order creation returned 503 upstream, the UI showed the friendly 'temporarily paused ... Nothing was charged' message, and dk-err-switch switched to #private-route. Chain tab: stats and feed match the API JSON and the feed refetches every 4s. I fixed a 10s->4s typo in the countdown. In-wallet vault: Swap jlUSDC->SOL shows the live quote, Relayer fee 0.109736 jlUSDC, NullCash fee 0.3%, and Minimum received. Send shows 'Free for private transfers'; Shield shows a 0.3% fee row. Bridge works with the vault and reloading #nullswap opens Bridge. BUG: clicking the Bridge tab leaves '#veilswap' in the address bar. Branding audit on /, /docs, /app/api, /app/docs, /app/security and 14 /app hash tabs: 0 hits.

minor.issue: Upstream still returns 503 'An active incident has unverified route impact. New orders ... paused'. Upstream outage. The UI fallback works.

ui_bugs.issue: With the connected label at 1024/1060/1100 (nav.side right edge 551/587/627), 'Privacy swap' (right 599) and the More button (601-672) are clipped by nav.side overflow:hidden. More is invisible, so Track/Chain/Bridge/History/Receive/Withdraw/Addresses/Keys cannot be reached. Without the connected label, More is also cut at 1024 and 1040 (nav right 626/642 < 672) and by about 10px at 1060. RCA: fitNav only moves OVF_ORDER=['chain','history','bridge','track'] into More. Once those are gone the core tabs (Home/Shield/Send/Swap/Private route/Privacy swap) plus More still overflow, and the loop stops because there is nothing left to move. 'nc-tight' only shrinks padding. Fix: extend OVF_ORDER with 'privacy swap','private route','send' (they appear in the More menu anyway), or shorten labels in nc-tight (e.g. 'Private', 'Privacy'). Measure with the More button included and recalc when the .wallet-btn label changes (use a ResizeObserver on header .top-right).

Clicking Bridge in nav.side leaves '/app#veilswap' in the address bar (tested with and without a vault). RCA: the app changes the hash with history.pushState/replaceState, which does not fire 'hashchange', so hashBrand() never runs. pretty() in the patched pushState does not rewrite veil->null. Fix: call hashBrand (or a veil->null rewrite) inside hpatch after f.call, or run hashBrand on popstate and on a short interval.

ui_bugs.component: Bridge deep link without a vault
ui_bugs.issue: Without a connected vault, loading /app#nullswap opens Home instead of the Bridge gate. Clicking the tab shows the Bridge connect gate. With a vault it works. Likely cause: setTimeout(hashBrand,1500) rewrites #veilswap back to #nullswap before the app finishes its splash and reads the hash. Low priority.

issues: After switching, the To asset and destination are reset; only the amount is kept, so the user has to pick USDC/ETH again. Consider carrying over the destination asset and address.

action_items: Fix fitNav so the More button is never clipped at 1024-1100px (with or without the connected label): allow core tabs (privacy swap, private route, send) to overflow into More, include the More button width in the overflow check, and recalc on wallet label changes.
Fix the address bar showing #veilswap after clicking the Bridge tab: apply the veil->null hash rewrite in the patched pushState/replaceState (hpatch), not only on hashchange.
Optional: make the #nullswap deep link open the Bridge gate when no vault is connected.
Optional: keep the receive asset and destination when the Privacy swap failure switches to Private route.
critical_code_review_comments: fitNav: the overflow loop is limited to 4 tabs and stops while nav.scrollWidth > clientWidth, so the remaining overflow is clipped silently. Add a fallback that keeps moving tabs while it still overflows.
bifrost_brand.py hashBrand only listens to 'hashchange'; SPA navigations through history API bypass it.

dk-swap.js chain render hardcoded 'sync 10s' while the poll is 4s, so the countdown read 4,3,2,10. Fixed to 4s. A duplicate stats/feed fetch about 0.3s after each 4s tick was also seen (two requests per tick); check that chLoad isn't triggered twice (render + timer).
React #418 hydration error still logs on /app/api (harmless now that the bf-ready keepalive restores visibility).

success_rate.frontend: about 88% (nav clipping at 1024-1100 and the #veilswap address bar still fail)
